paper.title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
paper.note: Grid extension: accuracy recovery across model size, STE filler length and chain-of-thought token cap. Not a paper replication.

notes: 0-shot, N=1000, paired seed 12345. Two Qwen3-2507 models (235B-A22B and 30B-A3B) x {baseline, STE 100/200/500 tokens} and four CoT caps {128, 256, 512, 2048}. The four CoT conditions must each use their own max_tokens; the harness builds one backend per (max_tokens, reasoning) pair. baseline/ste_filler/cot on the 235B model are already in the shared response cache from run dbcdb225 and are replayed at zero API cost.

request.note: hard 240s wall-clock deadline per attempt; 3 attempts + 7s backoff = 12.5 min worst case, under the 20m stall rule
